description: Implementation of the DatatypeService interface for managing custom datatypes and handlers within the OpenMRS framework. The class provides methods to retrieve, instantiate, and manage custom datatype classes and their handlers, as well as database storage for CLOB datatypes.

classes.name: DatatypeServiceImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the DatatypeService interface that manages custom datatype classes and their handlers, including database storage facilities for CLOB datatype storage.

methods.name: setDao
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object used for database operations related to ClobDatatypeStorage.

methods.name: getAllDatatypeClasses
methods.description: Retrieves all available custom datatype classes registered in the application context.

methods.name: getAllHandlerClasses
methods.description: Retrieves all registered custom datatype handler classes.

methods.name: populateBeanListsFromContext
methods.description: Loads registered datatype and handler components from the application context.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Instantiates a custom datatype class of the specified type with the provided configuration.

methods.name: getHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns handler classes applicable for a specific datatype class.

methods.name: datatypeClassHandled
methods.description: Determines the datatype class handled by a given type, traversing generics and inheritance.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a handler instance for a specific datatype with provided handler configuration.

methods.name: prioritizeHandlers
methods.description: Prepares a map of datatype classes to their primary handler classes for quick access.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Fetches ClobDatatypeStorage object by its ID.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorageByUuid
methods.description: Fetches ClobDatatypeStorage object by its UUID.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Saves a ClobDatatypeStorage object to the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
